basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Kondagaon Assistant Programmer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Zila Panchayat Kondagaon has announced 2 vacancies for the Assistant Programmer post on a contract basis. Eligible candidates must send their offline application in the prescribed format via registered post or speed post to the Office of the Collector, Zila Panchayat, District - Kondagaon (Room No. 35), Chhattisgarh on or before 6 November 2026. Applicants must possess an MCA, M.Sc, B.E., or B.Tech in Computer Science or IT. content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Kondagaon Assistant Programmer at a Glance

rows.details: MCA / M.Sc / B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science / IT

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format by registered post or speed post to the following address: Office of the Collector, Zila Panchayat, District - Kondagaon (Room No. 35), Chhattisgarh, Pin - 494226 Applicants must clearly write the name of the post applied for on top of the envelope. Applications sent directly in person, via email, or through any other electronic medium will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Candidates must hold a degree from a recognised university in MCA (Computer Science / Information Technology) or M.Sc (Computer Science / IT) or B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology or an equivalent degree from a recognised university. Age Limit: Minimum age is 21 years and maximum age is 35 years as on 1 January 2026. Age Relaxations: Age relaxations are applicable for Chhattisgarh native residents and various categories as per the rules and directives issued by the General Administration Department of Chhattisgarh from time to time, up to a maximum age limit of 45 years including all relaxations. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all educational qualification certificates and mark sheets. Caste certificate issued by a competent authority. Chhattisgarh domicile/residence certificate. Passport-size photograph (recent) affixed to the application form. Experience certificates (if claiming experience weightage). No objection certificate from current employer (if working in government or semi-government institutions).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a merit list prepared by assigning weightage to educational qualifications, a computer practical test, and work experience: Educational Qualification Weightage: Up to 45 marks based on the percentage obtained in the qualifying degree (minimum 60% marks required to be eligible). Computer Practical Test: 40 marks to test computer proficiency. Experience Weightage: Up to 15 marks based on experience working in government rural development schemes in Chhattisgarh (5 marks for at least 1 to 2 years of experience, 10 marks for up to 5 years, and 15 marks for more than 5 years of experience). Candidates will be called for the computer practical test in a 1:10 ratio based on merit.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Assistant Programmer post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a contract basis initially up to 28 February 2027, subject to review of necessity, work performance, conduct, and mutual agreement.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must be citizens of Chhattisgarh and must possess an MCA, M.Sc, B.E., or B.Tech degree in Computer Science or IT along with the required age limits between 21 and 35 years as on 1 January 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be enclosed with the offline application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of educational mark sheets and certificates, caste certificate, Chhattisgarh domicile certificate, passport-size photograph, experience certificates, and a no-objection certificate if applicable.

faq.question: Q4. How is the merit list prepared for selection?
faq.answer: The merit list is prepared giving 45 percent weightage to educational qualification marks, 40 marks for a computer practical test, and up to 15 marks for relevant work experience in government rural development schemes.
